sections.title: Income tax tariff 2026 (§ 33 EStG)

source.title: BMF: Steuertarif (last updated 1 January 2026)

sections.basis: Taxable income per person, per year (individual taxation; no joint returns)
sections.note: Thresholds raised by 1.733% for 2026 (two thirds of the 2.6% inflation rate); the 55% band over €1 million applies until 2029, then 50%. Employees' 13th and 14th salaries are taxed separately at fixed rates (see below).

sections.title: Tax credits (Absetzbeträge) 2026

rows.label: Supplement to the employee tax credit (Zuschlag, assessment only)
rows.value: €804 up to €19,761 of income, phasing out evenly to nil at €30,259

rows.label: Increased employee tax credit (with a commuter allowance)
rows.value: €853 up to €15,069 of income, phasing out evenly to €496 at €16,056

rows.label: Pensioner tax credit (Pensionistenabsetzbetrag)
rows.value: €1,020 up to €21,614 of income, phasing out evenly to nil at €31,494

rows.label: Sole earner / single parent credit: one child, per year
Sole earner / single parent credit: two children
Sole earner / single parent credit: three children
Sole earner / single parent credit: each further child adds
Sole earner credit: partner's income per year at most
Maintenance credit (Unterhaltsabsetzbetrag): first child, per month
Maintenance credit: second child, per month
Maintenance credit: third and each further child, per month

source.title: BMF: Steuerabsetzbeträge (last updated 1 January 2026)

sections.note: Credits are deducted from the tax; the pensioner credit and the employee credit cannot both apply. Low earners may receive part of their social insurance back (SV-Rückerstattung) on assessment.

sections.title: Familienbonus Plus and the Kindermehrbetrag

rows.label: Familienbonus Plus per child under 18, per year
Per child aged 18 or over (while family allowance is paid), per year
Kindermehrbetrag for low earners: up to, per child and year

source.title: BMF: Familienbonus Plus – alle Informationen (last updated 1 January 2026)

sections.note: A tax credit that reduces income tax to nil at most; it needs Austrian family allowance (Familienbeihilfe) for the child. The Kindermehrbetrag is paid when the tax is below €700 per child (single earners, single parents, or both partners on low income).

sections.title: 13th and 14th salary (sonstige Bezüge): fixed tax rates within the annual sixth

rows.label: Special payments above that, or above the annual sixth
rows.value: Taxed at the tariff together with the regular pay of the month; from regular annual pay of €500,000 all special payments are taxed at the marginal rate

rows.label: No tax on special payments of up to (Freigrenze 2026)

source.title: BMF: Das Steuerbuch 2026 (Wien 2025), chapter F. Sonstige Bezüge, pp. 67–68

sections.basis: Special payments (holiday and Christmas pay, bonuses) up to one sixth of the regular pay of the year, after the social insurance on them
sections.note: With steady pay the annual sixth equals two monthly salaries, i.e. the 13th and 14th salary (§ 67 EStG).

Housing contribution in Vienna from 1 January 2026

sections.basis: Gross pay up to the contribution ceiling (below); special payments have their own annual ceiling
sections.note: Blue- and white-collar workers pay the same rates. No AK levy and no housing contribution on special payments. In Vienna the employee total is 18.32%.
